_note: Hand-authored ideal extraction - not asserted automatically. Reproduces a real live bug (2026-09-28): a Google Calendar/Ashby-style interview invite is almost entirely UI boilerplate (AI Notetaker opt-out, 'add to calendar' links, no plain 'you have an interview for X at Y' sentence). qwen extracted event.type: interview with a correct occurred_at, but separately set job_related: false - which silently dismisses the whole submission before anything else is looked at, dropping a real interview with no reply to the operator. guardInterviewImpliesJobRelated in extractor.ts now corrects job_related back to true (and email_kind to interview_scheduled) whenever the model contradicts itself this way.
